The Chapter of the Cat and Rat

p.n: The King Asks about Escaping Enemies

body.p:
“I have understood what you mentioned of the matters of government and reason,” said the King to the Philosopher,
“and how a man of both stands to benefit. Now, tell me the parable of the man who, outnumbered by enemies
and on the brink of perishing, sought a way out through reconciling with one of them, was saved from that which had frightened him, and kept his promise
